pages.title: The Court of Truth
pages.text: The first alchemist to seek the truth: the sins, the Four Symbols and the origin itself came out of his Great Work. He waits in the $(l)Court of Truth$(), north of the Primordial Temple.$(br2)$(l)To enter$() you must yourself have fought the $(l)Primordial Lord$() to its fall (the killing blow, or within 64 blocks when it fell).$(br2)The $(l)Primordial Gate$() due north of the temple's arena leads there; a gate on the court's south rim brings you back to the arrival island.

pages.title: Omniscience
pages.text: 4000 health, 18 armor, 16 melee (withering).$(br2)$(l)Omniscience$(): it sees through whichever kind of harm has hurt it most of late ($(l)blades, missiles or spells$()) and takes 30% less of it.$(br2)When you see the warning, change weapons.

pages.title: Nigredo (100%-75%)
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Solve$(): black circles under everyone burst, 12 and withering, leaving pools of rot for 6 seconds (slowing, harming)$(li)$(l)The Four Symbols$(): the guardians' arts in turn: the Tiger's three rakes, the Tortoise's geysers, the Dragon's thunder, the Bird's feathers$(li)$(l)Shrinking the Earth$(): a step to behind its prey, and a blow

pages.title: Albedo (75%-50%)
pages.text: $(l)Coagula$(): it rises behind a ward, taking only 10% and slowly healing, while the circles of $(l)water, wood, fire and metal$() light at the arena's quarters.$(br2)$(l)Stand in each for 5 seconds$() to purify it; all four, and the ward shatters: stunned 6 seconds, it takes 50% more.$(br2)Not done in 60 seconds, and $(l)every circle left takes 20% of everyone's health$().$(br)From now on it also $(l)Purges$() everyone's blessings.

pages.title: Citrinitas (50%-25%)
pages.text: Enraged, 20% more harm.$(li)$(l)The Golden Rule$(): two beams of gold turn round it for 6 seconds, 8 a touch. $(l)The nearer it you are, the easier to keep ahead$()$(li)$(l)Equivalent Exchange$(): it takes all its prey's blessings for its own (healing 1% for each) and trades places with it

pages.title: Rubedo (25%-0%)
pages.text: The Stone wakes: it moves faster, the Golden Rule turns with $(l)four$() beams and quicker, and anyone within 6 blocks bleeds life into it.$(br2)$(l)Final Transmutation$(): every 40 seconds one of the four circles lights; 7 seconds later, $(l)everyone outside it loses half their health$(). Read the colour and run.

pages.title: The Great Work Done
pages.text: It drops the $(l)Philosopher's Stone$(), the $(l)Gem Sword$()'s recipe, three Divinity Shards, the $(l)Sage's Sigil$() and alchemy recipes.$(br2)It leaves a statue where it fell; right-click it with the Sage's Sigil to wake it.
